newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended down after falling in the morning, then recovering, then easing again.
The market was pressured early by sharp declines in LIFFE's three-month EuroSwiss futures contract.

Traders cited technical factors and nervousness tied to market speculation that the Swiss National Bank could be moving towards a tighter policy. The speculation followed comments made by SNB president Hans Meyer to a parliamentary committee. The committee published the comments late on Tuesday. But on Wednesday morning the SNB reaffirmed its policy was still generous, as the economy has shown no significant changes.
Eurofima's increase had little, if any, price impact on the issue, traders said. It was quoted at 3.94 percent in late trade compared with 3.95 late on Tuesday.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down 20 at 110.85
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down 10 at 97.97.
